question:
In the given figure, ∠ABD = 55° and ∠ACD = 30°, If ∠BAC = y° and non-reflex ∠BDC = x°, then what is the value of (x - y)?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8476a4e4be3e5abf613b476d25779e8c3b08c451a1261b4d3ac2c58068fa105b.png]
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80fa57f38ca8b116abae3873a9d43bf22f2c1230a62cc21a102148e52b6f486d.png] 

∠ABD = 55° and ∠ACD = 30°

**Calculation:**

∠BAD = α and ∠CAD = β 

So, ∠BAC = y = α + β

So Referring to the triangle ΔABD and ΔACD,

∠ADB = 180°- α - 55°

∠ADC = 180°- β - 30°

For point D,

∠ADB +∠ADC + x = 360°

⇒ 180°- α - 55° + 180°- β - 30° + x = 360°

⇒ 360 - α - β - 85° + x = 360

⇒ x - (α + β) - 85° = 0

⇒ x - y - 85° = 0

⇒ x -y = 85°

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
